text:
incident-bot: ALERT: rolling p99 spike on streaming endpoints (EU prod) — SLO breach detected for 2026-03-15 14:12 UTC. p95=210ms, p99=4.1s, streaming stall count +420 in last 10m. Affected route: /v1/stream/generate. Pager sent to @Raj. See dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/prod/streams?panel=tail_latency

Raj: oncall here. digging in — paging SRE. timeline pls if you have traces.

Jamal: looking. I see tail chunks not leaving proxy for some sessions. Proxy write_timeouts = 45s, ALB keepalive 60s. There's a cohort of connections with repeated TCP retransmits before proxy attempts to write next chunk. Attaching quick log excerpt:
```
[14:09:51] proxy=stream-proxy-3 write attempt -> client.sock write timeout after 45s
[14:09:51] upstream OK, queued chunks=0
[14:10:20] client retransmit, rtt spike, stalled streaming chunk
[14:11:33] session terminated by ALB (keepalive timeout)
```

Jamal: root cause hypothesis: client backpressure + proxy write_timeout too low -> proxy gives up before network recovers, causing partial streams and increased p99 due to retransmit+reconnect penalties. Also some requests hit ALB idle timeout which tears TCP mid-stream.

Elena: confirming from runtime traces — KV cache not the issue, tokens generating fine. The problem is delivery layer (SSE/Ws) patience. We have a small set of customers with slow consumers (mobile clients on flaky networks) + a proxy config tuned for throughput that is aggressive on write timeouts.

Alex: proposed mitigations (fast->slow):
1) Immediately increase streaming-proxy write_timeout to 120s and keepalive to 90s (hotfix).
2) Enable periodic heartbeat chunks every 20s for active streams (small ":\nheartbeat\n" bytes) to keep ALB and client from idling.
3) For highest-risk customers, flip them to non-streaming fallback (polling) for the next 2 hours via routing rule.

DevDeployBot: available canary slot on edge-us-west-1. Hotpatch requires configmap change + rolling restart of stream-proxy DaemonSet. ETA ~ 6m for config rollout if approved.

Raj: do the hotpatch. Jamal, please coordinate. Maria, Tash — can you confirm which customers are seeing truncation so we can apply routing fallback?

Maria: CS report — Customers: AcmeAnalytics (high), SurveyCloud (medium), EduStream (low). Acme reported truncated transcripts and reconnect storms. Tash is calling Acme now and will relay the mitigation timeline.

Jamal: doing hotpatch now. Steps I'm running:
```
kubectl -n infra edit configmap streaming-proxy-config
# set write_timeout: "120s"
# set heartbeat_interval: "20s"
kubectl rollout restart daemonset/stream-proxy -n infra
```
Applying to EU prod first (canary on eu-1-b).

Elena: parallel patch ready to reduce chunk size flush frequency (reduce default chunk to 8kb -> 2kb) — that'll help slow consumers accept chunks more frequently. I will hold unless p99 doesn't drop after proxy change.

DevDeployBot: canary deploy started (eu-1-b). Status: 1/1 ready.

Jamal: canary observed — within 4m p99 dropped from 4.1s -> 720ms, stall count down ~78%. P95 unchanged. Logs show fewer write_timeouts.

Raj: nice. proceed to rollout to all EU proxies. Keep US unchanged for now.

Jamal: rolling to eu.* nodes. Rolling restart in progress (4 nodes). Monitoring p99/p95 and stall_count.

Tash (CS): Acme on call — they saw improvement, streaming resumed without reconnects. They asked for an RCA and ETA for full fix. I told them 30m for EU roll and we'll follow up.

Alex: after EU roll, recommended to also add short-term routing rule: clients with header X-Fallback=true go to polling endpoint. Maria, please coordinate.

Maria: creating routing rule now for AcmeAnalytics.

Jamal: EU rollout complete. p99 now 380ms, p95 200ms, stall_count back to baseline. No new write_timeouts in logs for canaried nodes.

Elena: I'll schedule the chunk-size change behind a quick canary in 1 hour and follow up with a small patch to ensure heartbeat chunk is sent even if no tokens yet (preemptive flush).

Raj: thanks team. Actions summary:
- Jamal: proxy write_timeout -> 120s + heartbeat 20s (done, EU complete, global scheduled).
- Maria/Tash: routing fallback for AcmeAnalytics (done).
- Elena: chunk-size reduction + preemptive heartbeat canary in 1h.
- Alex: follow-up on ALB keepalive alignment with proxy settings (create infra ticket).

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied, SLOs returning to normal. Marking paging resolved but keeping watch for 3h.

Raj: closing handoff — leaving postmortem assignment to Jamal+Elena+CS to draft. Will add notes to incidents board and set severity to Sev2. :white_check_mark:

Maria: filing customer comms draft and will circulate.

Jamal: starting postmortem doc template now. Will include logs, commands, metrics snapshots, and timeline.

Elena: added a small perf note — consider adding explicit HTTP/2 path for streaming clients to reduce connection churn; will discuss in runtime sync.

Raj: thanks everyone — monitoring for 30m then will change incident state to resolved if stable.
